narrative: Round 0 raised real defects: the sweep's rooms-before-log race, last-write-wins in the ends fold, `els.apiKey` throwing on every load, a double-join race, and missing Abandoned tests. Before replying to any of them, the agent pushed 1fc9259, which removed caller auth entirely, and then b15d96f, which reinstated it as `Option<XiApiKey>`. Rounds 1 and 2 therefore re-raised every unaddressed round-0 defect (the sweep race eleven times in total) and added findings on the redesign's own new code. b15d96f even restored the round-0 `els.apiKey` bug verbatim and recreated the one-pass config-reporting gap F9/F13 had named. Every finding was then answered at once, after round 2, and fixed in 266add3. The pushbacks on retired code (F9, F13, F21, F27, F30, F31, F35) check out against the b15d96f diff.
guidance_observations: Pushing design-pivot commits while a review round's findings sit unanswered makes the reviewer re-raise all of them; fix or reply to the open findings before or alongside the pivot.
When reinstating code an intervening commit deleted, re-apply every open finding against it, since b15d96f brought back a TypeError flagged three times in round 0.
When making a shared field nullable (`xiApiKey ?? null`), migrate every consumer in the same commit; one unmigrated script drew three findings.
The reviewer duplicates heavily (up to five near-identical findings per defect per round), so finding counts here overstate distinct defects roughly threefold.
